title: A team may review each spec as one pull request

statements.says: Pushing straight to the default branch stays the default.
A team that reviews its work through pull requests can still run the loop.
target-branch in docs/agents/loop.json says which: a branch name, such as main or master, or spec.
The loop never assumes the default branch is called main.
With spec, each spec gets a branch of its own, spec/<slug>, and one pull request takes the whole spec to the default branch.
The spec's branch is its Target branch, and tickets Land on it exactly as they Land on main.
A closed ticket still means its code is on the Target branch.
The grill creates the spec's branch and a draft pull request with the first word or ADR it settles, and pushes every later one there.
to-spec writes the branch name into the spec, and the loop reads it from there.
A settled word is still pushed the moment it settles, but to the spec's branch rather than the default branch.
A ticket still Lands the moment it passes, but on its Target branch.
One pull request for each ticket is deferred, not rejected, and can come later as a third value of target-branch.
When two specs in flight take the same ADR number or edit the same glossary entry, the second pull request meets an ordinary merge conflict, and no agent resolves it.
A ticket is closed before its code reaches the default branch, and the spec reaches it whole when a person merges the pull request.
Renaming the default branch is too much to ask of a team that only wants to try the Plugin.
Because tickets Land on the spec's branch as they Land on main, blocking, the push race and running with nobody watching all carry over.
One pull request for each ticket would leave the loop idle through every review, a squash merge would drop the Session trailer, and every settled word would become a pull request of its own.

Having the grill push to the default branch while only code goes through the pull request was rejected, because a team that reviews through pull requests usually protects its default branch, so every push from the grill would be refused.
Stacked pull requests were rejected, because a ticket's blockers form a graph, not a line, so a ticket with two blockers has no single base.
It amends the decision that a settled word is pushed to the default branch the moment it settles.
It amends the decision that a ticket Lands on main the moment it passes.
